stem_book: The van't Hoff reaction isotherm is: (a) ΔG° = RT logₑ Kp (b) −ΔG° = RT logₑ Kp (c) ΔG° = RT² ln Kp (d) none of these
reason: Print writes ΔG for ΔG° in every option; the relation holds only for the standard change, so ° added.
work: At equilibrium ΔG = 0 = ΔG° + RT ln Kp → −ΔG° = RT ln Kp → (b)
